what: a cylinder r5 tilted 26.6 deg from Z cut flat at z = 10, its elliptical rim chamfered 1 and 2: built, or refused as not supported, never a wrong solid
method: the axis (1, 0, 2)/sqrt5 through (0, 0, -10) meets z = 10 at (10, 0, 10); the rim is the ellipse there with semi-axes 5 (along y) and 5 sqrt5/2 (along x); (10, 5, 10) is on it. An unequal chamfer of an ellipse has no closed-form volume: one closed valid solid, or a refusal that names the rim as not supported yet (never an SMLib status).
